title: My Dad's Knot Creaks TIGHTER Every Night 🪢
description:
Every promise you make here ties a glowing knot over your head, and you don't want one pulling tight. My dad has the oldest knot in town, gray and hard and ten years old. This August it started creaking a turn tighter every night.

So I went back up the hill to his observatory for the week of falling stars, for the first time since he left. He wasn't alone up there.

It's made up, a creepy blocky story built with code and Blender.
pin: Comment KNOT if you still owe somebody a promise.
